purpose: Three full-body human NPC options and three full-body player-body options with interchangeable profile heads. Concepts for Roy's selection.

options.label: NPC A1 — Letter keeper
options.subject: Friendly middle-aged human man, warm medium skin, a little grey in short dark hair, natural gentle smile. Ink-blue short-brim keeper cap with no emblem, short navy collared jacket over cream shirt, navy trousers ending above simple brown walking shoes. Small cream cross-body letter satchel resting at the hip; hands relaxed and visible. Entire two trouser legs and both shoes clearly visible. A human NPC with a normal illustrated head attached to his neck, NO avatar disc.
options.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: full-body standing character sprite for the Time Capsule live map.
Primary request: Friendly middle-aged human man, warm medium skin, a little grey in short dark hair, natural gentle smile. Ink-blue short-brim keeper cap with no emblem, short navy collared jacket over cream shirt, navy trousers ending above simple brown walking shoes. Small cream cross-body letter satchel resting at the hip; hands relaxed and visible. Entire two trouser legs and both shoes clearly visible. A human NPC with a normal illustrated head attached to his neck, NO avatar disc.
A COMPLETE FULL-BODY MAP CHARACTER SPRITE with a head, torso, both arms, two separate legs and TWO COMPLETE VISIBLE SHOES. This is a small human figure standing on a map, not a profile picture or bust. Show the entire person from the top of the hair/hat to the soles of both feet, with generous transparent space around the whole figure. Single standing character only; no contact sheet, no circle background, no portrait framing, no map, no terrain or scenery. Upright front three-quarter view, camera a little elevated so the tops of shoulders and shoes are visible, suitable as a billboard sprite over a map pitched about 40 degrees. Gentle storybook proportions about 4 head-heights tall, compact readable silhouette, not anime chibi. Clean separated limbs and clear footwear at 64–120 px. Feet meet a common baseline near y=880 on a square 1024 canvas, centered x=512; full character fills roughly y=150–880. Soft top-left lighting, subtle paper grain and thick clean plum/navy outlines, flat fills plus one shadow tone. No text or logos, no border, no pedestal, no pin point, no enclosing circle, no cast ground shadow. Genuinely transparent background.
Input images: Image 1 is design/art/style-sheet.png, the APPROVED style reference: match its hand-inked storybook line, restrained flat colours and gentle texture exactly. Image 2 is an approved existing HUMAN PROFILE PORTRAIT, only a face/style reference; adapt its human rendering to a new full-body person, not the portrait composition. Image 3 is a SCREENSHOT OF THE EXISTING MAP only to understand the viewing angle and intended sprite size. Do NOT reproduce, redraw or generate the map. Only output the isolated FULL-BODY PERSON WITH BOTH FEET.
Natural human skin/hair tones should follow the approved human portrait reference; garments and accessories use the approved Time Capsule palette.
App: 時光膠囊 / Time Capsule. People send a sealed letter that can only be opened at a set time and place. Mood: tender, human, nostalgic, "precious in the AI age". Hand-inked storybook, not glossy 3D.
- Clean ink line art with a slightly hand-drawn line, flat colour fills plus one soft shading tone, a little paper grain, light hatching only (it must still read at about 120 px). Lines in plum #6E2B3F or navy #16263F.
- Palette only: ink blue #2F5D8A, light blue #5A8FD0, glass blue #DCE8F2, plum #6E2B3F, brass #C9A15A, wax red #A3364F, navy #16263F, paper #F6F8FB, cream #F3E2BB. Warm brown wood is allowed for wooden objects.
- Front three-quarter view, soft top-left light. No text, letters, numbers, logos or real brands.
- Transparent background, object centred, generous padding (object fills about 70% of the canvas), square.
Match the attached style sheet exactly.
FINAL PRIORITY: one complete FULL-BODY map figure on transparent square canvas. Never crop at the chest, waist, knees or ankles. No circular portrait card around the whole person.

Ink-blue cardigan, small wax-red neck scarf, straight navy cropped trousers and low brass-brown loafers. One hand raised in a small welcoming gesture, the other relaxed. Show both legs and both complete shoes. A human NPC with a normal illustrated head attached to her neck, NO avatar disc.
